specifications.name: Rated capacity
specifications.conditions: 20-hour discharge rate. Temperature and cutoff voltage are not specified in this catalogue.

specifications.name: Rated capacity
specifications.conditions: 100-hour discharge rate. Temperature and cutoff voltage are not specified in this catalogue.

limitations: Historical S-550 specification; do not apply to successor models or different revisions.
Ratings do not establish current capacity, state of charge, usable energy or installed wiring.
This catalogue does not provide charging settings or maintenance procedures.

monitoringOptions.purpose: Candidate for bidirectional bank current, consumed Ah and estimated state of charge.
monitoringOptions.limitations: Origin89 integration pending. Verify installed bank voltage (6.5–70 V), maximum current including surges, monitoring mode and capacity configuration before selecting a rating.

monitoringOptions.purpose: Directional DC voltage, current and power monitoring on a suitable circuit.
monitoringOptions.limitations: Not a bidirectional battery-bank coulomb counter; no reliable bank state of charge. External shunt range and powered RS485 interface must match.

limitations: Passive batteries have no digital port or self-reported telemetry; measurements come from an external monitor.
Catalogue Ah is a rated capacity at stated test conditions, not present usable capacity or state of health.

evidence.note: Rolls/Surrette passive lead-acid research; no battery communications protocol.
Current decoder coverage: PZEM DC V/A/W; EPEVER B-series battery voltage only. No SmartShunt or IPower decoder.
